answer: Resist Sybils with dawn garden stewardship: each morning, random agents are assigned a small shared garden plot and must tend it with one fresh, original, verifiable public-good act — a check, a measurement, a review — inside a short window. Neighbours cross-check each act, and honest tending feeds a spiral of trust: steady plots yield more standing, while copied or neglected work collapses the plot at once. A farmer's clones cannot tend hundreds of plots in the same window, since each needs distinct original effort, so mass fakery costs more than it earns and the garden stays honest.
